description: Project-level module registry. Resources stay the truth-store owner; modules group those resources into daemon, client, shared, relay, release, and observability ownership boundaries before function-map or runtime refactor.

modules.responsibility: Top-level product runtime boundary across daemon, client, shared protocol, relay, release, and observability modules.
Daemon-side process, backend, mirror, transport subscriber, input, schedule, file, and remote-window runtime boundary.
Android client app shell, connection, session, channel, buffer, renderer, input, drawer, preview, remote-window overlay, and settings projection boundary.
Own Android IME/hardware/paste/quick-action committed-text normalization before terminal or remote-window input intent.
Shared protocol, resource contracts, terminal types, connection types, and test contracts consumed by daemon and clients.
Own framework-neutral plugin manifests, capability ports, lifecycle contracts, unique capability registry, and typed UI slot registry consumed by the client plugin host.
Own branded control command, result, correlation, deadline, idempotency, and audit contracts without terminal/file/media body truth.
Own runtime node identity, lifecycle, disposal, subscription, and adjacent typed node contracts without business state or routing policy.
Own typed debug snapshots, events, filters, sensitivity classes, bounded stores, and expiring debug permission contracts without business mutations.
Relay account directory, signaling, public update route, and bounded peer-lease runtime boundary.
Build, package, promote, update, and installed runtime artifact boundary.
Debug side channel, architecture registry, test design, and governance gate boundary.
Wire daemon runtime modules, health/control routes, and process lifetime.

Own daemon endpoint discovery/publication, the persistent Relay host control connection, and physical client ingress from direct, Tailscale, WebRTC, and Relay routes; expose only terminal-channel subscriber interfaces inward.
Own the terminal source adapter contract shared by tmux, Herdr, and WezTerm backends and by mirror capture readback normalization.

Own validated terminal source snapshot capture, source-neutral canonicalization, and authoritative mirror snapshot commit writes; it never owns mirror revision truth, per-subscriber publication, backend session truth, or client policy.
Own backend session identity for tmux, WezTerm, and official Herdr single-terminal sources.
Own daemon canonical terminal rows, cols, cursor, revision, absolute index, and runtime capture scheduling; snapshot commit writes belong to daemon.mirror_writer.

Own per-subscriber buffer-sync pending state, range merge/collapse, backpressure hysteresis, head broadcast cache, oversized contiguous same-revision frame split, trace stages, and explicit flush statuses from daemon mirror truth to physical transport subscribers.
Own daemon channel transport envelope creation, channel subscriber registration, connection channel registry mutations, and explicit per-channel/all-channel release.

Own authenticated typed control ingress from terminal message dispatch and typed daemon command owner registration; it routes schedule and tmux control intents to the daemon control center without owning business truth or data bodies.
Own backend session catalog construction and list-sessions control dispatch, including backend-qualified session rows, without owning client active/session state.
Own daemon control command capability gating, deadline, idempotency, correlation, unique routing, and bounded audit without owning business decisions or terminal/file/media bodies.

Own daemon physical body subscription eligibility, send accounting, and transport backpressure snapshots per terminal channel; bounded pending-latest publication state belongs to daemon.buffer_publisher.
Own daemon input receive, stale/drop policy, retry ack/nack, dedupe, queueing, and backend write ordering.
Own daemon scheduled send rules, timers, next-fire calculation, dispatch, and result status.
Own daemon-derived tmux session idle/stopped classification and control-channel publication.
Own daemon file-transfer state and remote screenshot transfer handoff through backend session truth.

Own typed remote-window gateway/session lifecycle plus the active catalog, daemon-only canvas layout generation, ScreenCaptureKit capture/cadence, focus/overview group quality transaction, input helper, action injection, and exact cleanup.
Own Android platform terminal surface, page shell, navigation, and UI projection container.
Own the client plugin host lifecycle, declared capability injection, plugin-provided capability registration, typed UI slot registry consumption, and deterministic start/stop/dispose.
Own the typed debug console UI contract, terminal debug session projection, and TerminalPage debug overlay slot renderer consumed through the plugin host UI slot registry.

Own the typed session drawer UI slot contract consumed through the plugin host UI slot registry; it never owns drawer preview selection, preview mode, renderer, transport, or backend projection truth.
Own declared client runtime port binding, validation, and resolution used by App composition; it never owns transport, session, buffer, renderer, plugin implementation, or business truth.
Own client control command authorization, capability gating, deadline, idempotency, correlation, unique routing, and bounded audit; it never owns business truth or data bodies.
Own shared phone and desktop pane layout profiles consumed by platform shell projections.
Own client-visible daemon target identity projection: named server, saved direct/Tailscale route candidates, relay directory candidates, and connection settings entry.

Own one client physical connection per daemon target, route health, open intent, and transport reuse. Application features use this interface instead of opening sockets; per-session channel identity is consumed from client.terminal_channel_mux.
Own current-process open-tab and active-session truth. It does not persist current tabs and does not own sockets.
Own per-session terminal-channel identity over the daemon-target physical transport, including channel open/close state, target-scoped demux, and body-subscription intent.
Own bounded authoritative frame assembly, explicit frame rejection truth, exact repair range, and one dispatched repair per retained revision.
Own validated client wire ingress normalization and frame identity decoding before frame assembly.
Own absolute-row local terminal truth and committed immutable sparse snapshots; no follow/reading/render bottom.
Own client buffer orchestration: planner/pull/repair runtime and head/tail refresh truth; consumes sparse body truth without owning it.
Own renderer visible range, follow/reading/renderBottomIndex, immutable render snapshot projection, next-RAF commit, and fixed-width crop; DOM projection handoff belongs to client.dom_renderer.

Own immutable render snapshot to DOM projection: TerminalView, visible/preview row nodes, visual scale layer, and shared cell render helpers; never owns follow/reading/renderBottomIndex or request policy.

Own Android terminal stage shell, shell skin, stage status projection, shell action routing, keyboard lift, and terminal shell UI primitives; it consumes renderer/DOM projections and emits user intent only.
Own platform input channel, IME anchor, QuickBar text/key intent, and terminal/remote-window input dispatch boundary.
Own reliable terminal input sequence allocation, ACK tracking, timeout retry, route-generation retry, and queue cleanup.
Own session drawer projection, ordered preview selection, preview mode, layout, body promotion, add/remove/replace, and cancel-to-entry projection.
Own Android remote-window picker/floating/fullscreen overlay projection, video receiver projection, touch/action classification, screenshot intent, bitrate UI, and IME/QuickBar avoidance.
Client file browsing, preview, selection, upload/download projection, file-transfer intent boundary, and the typed file browser UI slot contract rendered only through the plugin host.

Settings projection for config transfer, app update route candidates, release/update install intent, shared Settings UI primitives, and the typed settings update UI slot contract rendered only through the plugin host. Connection target and server profile projection belongs to client.connection_home.
Own the typed remote window UI slot contract consumed through the plugin host UI slot registry; it never owns remote-window transport, media, capture, touch dispatch, or overlay projection truth.
Own the typed quickbar UI slot contract consumed through the plugin host UI slot registry; it never owns input normalization, transport, session, mirror, sparse, renderer, or UI projection truth.

Own the typed terminal shell UI slot contract consumed through the plugin host UI slot registry; it never owns transport, session, mirror, sparse, renderer, terminal body, or input normalization truth.
Own shared wire protocol request/response/error frame definitions used by daemon and clients.
Own machine-readable module/resource/edge review contracts and their static gates.
Shared terminal geometry, rows, buffer, and renderer-facing type contracts.
modules.owned_paths_note: android/src/lib entries include re-export shells over @zterm/shared, client-local layered types, and the stable TerminalShortcutAction preset contract consumed by types.ts; terminal wire truth lives in packages/shared.

modules.responsibility: Shared connection target, route candidate, route health, and selected route metadata contract.
Shared test-contract owners for resource, module, edge, function, and mainline gates.
Deterministic Vitest/jsdom environment bootstrap for client tests, including an in-memory browser Storage instance.
Own independent per-login account tokens, role-scoped Relay control connection presence, account-scoped machine/daemon/endpoint/tmux-session directory, and public update route facts.
Own only idle-timeout bounded route/signaling peer leases keyed by account, daemon target, and concrete client device.
Own runtime home path and staged runtime state root.
Own APK/update/daemon release outputs and verifier-controlled promotion source.
Own deterministic staged daemon runtime artifact consumed by process start.
Own metadata-only diagnostics, runtime debug snapshots, trace summaries, and local evidence readers.
Own durable image attachment files, preview/original integrity, per-device delivery receipts, API enqueue/read, transport-message query/asset/receipt projection, and 48-hour expiry cleanup.
Own overview-to-focus remote-window switch revisions, projection commit, stale-result rejection, and explicit switch errors; never own capture or macOS geometry truth.

Own the project-side preflight that resolves one AppSDK executable, verifies its project/lock version and digest, invokes record-graph verification through that exact executable, and owns only the deterministic generated module artifact emitted by the pinned compiler.

Sole Android native owner of the physical WebSocket transport, route auth, mux handshake, heartbeat, network-generation validation, reconnect/backoff, and desired route policy. UI never owns transport, heartbeat, or reconnect. (Slice status: design until native transport ownership is installed and verified.)
